_comment: Residue gate: language-neutral segments a pattern cannot safely classify. class: proper-noun (person/institution name) | homograph-unit (unit/expression whose only non-predicate token is an English homograph like bar/log) | neutral-notation (international scientific notation — amino-acid sequences, chemical-formula chains — where the EN bytes ARE the correct Icelandic). Exact match moduleId+segmentId; drift/invalid-class/missing-reason → still flagged. Entries triaged from the item-9 #294 MT run: each EN/IS pair was read individually. The image-only stems that also failed that run are NOT here — they were root-caused in code (pure-opaque runs are translation-invariant). See docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-14-residue-gate-retriage-design.md
